name: fog-maps-plus
description: FoW+: map views stay limited to what each seat knows, and Sol can activate a000 on map A through the sector picker (only visible systems, Blind Tile offered).

steps.note: you = sol (carrier at 305, alpha wormhole to a000); seat1 = hacan (destroyer at a301). FoW+ forces Hide Unexplored Map.

steps.label: Sol may not open map A's rest

expect.ephemeral: That part of the map is not available to you.

steps.label: Hacan may not open A / outpost

expect.ephemeral: That part of the map is not available to you.

steps.label: The picker offers map A's sector (Sol sees a000)

steps.note: By hand: move the carrier from 305 into a000; unexplored tiles stay hidden (Hide Unexplored Map), ghost rings still show numbered frontier hexes; Blind Tile with a void map A hex (e.g. a404) sends ships into The Void.
